body:
FINAL NOTE, helper-p117, 14 Nov evening (replaces my status note). IN: #60 (slice 1: B-77, B-78, B-130 stop-gap; CI green). BUILT AND PUSHED, NOT OPENED (ordered: after #60 and the B-128 code PR #63): task/P1-17-reach-state (slice 2 on main: the one state, resolver finding, strip presenter, readers, old providers deleted, D1 and D2 pins with their docs), task/P1-17-player-reach (slice 3, stacked on 2: one read, one recheckServer, one listener in the engine), task/P1-17-server-kind (slice 4, stacked on 3: serverKindProvider). Each passes the whole suite (2810 to 2815 tests) on its own base. PR bodies are ready at C:\Users\marwa\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\e391e7eb1f701290\e12eedaf-4d35-4479-ac2f-29d120f1d4d8\scratchpad: pr2-head.md + p117-plan-final.md (concatenate: the plan is the end of the PR2 body), pr3-body.md, pr4-body.md; replace #PR2/#PR3/#PR4 in the audit rows after opening.
TO OPEN, after #63 merges: in each worktree (wt-p117-state, wt-p117-player on its branch) `git merge origin/main`, expect conflicts only in app/lib/app/playback_providers.dart and features/instant/song_marks.dart (two lines); re-run `flutter test --exclude-tags perf,live`; open the three PRs in order (slice 3 base = slice 2's branch, slice 4 base = slice 3's), PR titles start with "P1-17:".
OPEN DECISION for the lead (blocks `roadmap.py mark P1-17 built`, which I did NOT run): ServerSession.encoreMode is still read directly by the code that holds the session to reach session.encore (keep, news, people, import, release save, downloads, the player's address builder). Same answer as the kind by construction, but a second read of "which kind". (a) keep them, as docs/31 2b says; (b) one session accessor, an Encore API that is null unless in Encore mode, so encoreMode becomes private (about a dozen one-line changes, my recommendation). When decided: run `python tools/roadmap.py mark P1-17 built --evidence "..."` in the last PR.
TRAPS MET: (1) in a widget test an unmocked MethodChannel call (Android's internet check) never completes, so a state that WAITED for the answer never decided: the state is set first from the last answer and refined when Android answers. (2) noNetwork is at once for rows and player, but the strip must keep its own 4 s hold for a blink of the radio (D-45), so the strip has one hold of its own. (3) the strip test timing: shown for 60 ms in a test, so check inside that window. (4) CHANGELOG.md conflicts at the top of the list on every merge of main: keep both lines. (5) a changed finding now ALSO fires on invalidate (D1), so the outbox retry fires after every network change, which is harmless and better. (6) serverKindProvider must keep the kind while the session is REBUILT (isLoading with a value), pinned.
NOT PROVEN: anything on a phone; Android's real internet answer; the Linux goldens (compared on Windows here only); D1 (rows look normal for 5 to 8 s after a network change during an outage) and D2 (a tap in the 4 s after the server goes silent is tried and waits) are accepted trade-offs, pinned by tests and written in docs/31 and docs/33, never seen. B-130 (stop-gap) stands until P2-20 or a Your-server line.
